Cabanas.heroSubtitle: Nature, relaxation and a complete escape
Cabanas.intro: Wake up each morning surrounded by the green colors of nature and end the day with the magic of a sunset. Our cabins, designed with a rustic yet modern touch, are surrounded by stunning landscapes that invite you to relax and disconnect.
Cabanas.introHighlight: Here, every sunrise brings you peace and every sunset becomes a moment to treasure. Come and experience tranquility at its finest.
Cabanas.poolAccess: Access to the pool and green areas
Cabanas.cabin2Description: A perfect hideaway to enjoy as a couple.
Cabanas.cabin2Details: Open-plan suite with a 30m2 panoramic roof. Tucked away among shrubs and trees in front of the main pool, it features a 15m2 terrace.
Cabanas.cabin4Description: A cozy space ideal for unforgettable family experiences.
Cabanas.cabin4Details: Family cabin with two bedrooms and an open-plan kitchen, covering 40m2. It is located in front of a children's play area beneath the shade of pine trees and features a 20m2 terrace.
Cabanas.cabin6Description: A cozy cabin for large families and groups of friends.
Cabanas.cabin6Details: Family cabin with three bedrooms and an open-plan kitchen, covering 65m2. It is located in front of the cascading water fountain and features a 30m2 terrace.
Cabanas.finalCta: Book your ideal cabin or request a quote for your event with us.

Empresas.heroImageAlt: Corporate events at Valle del Sol
Empresas.heroSubtitle: Premium spaces for meetings, training sessions, celebrations and unforgettable experiences.
Empresas.servicesStrip: Training • Seminars • Conferences • Corporate Partnerships • Year-End Events
Empresas.infrastructureDescription: At Valle del Sol Quillón, we offer modern spaces, extensive green areas and comprehensive services for meetings, strategic sessions, conventions, celebrations and fully customized corporate events.
Empresas.roomsBenefitDescription: Flexible setups for every type of activity.
Empresas.teamBuildingBenefitDescription: Activities designed to strengthen team integration and motivation.
Empresas.cateringBenefitDescription: Coffee breaks, lunches and corporate dinners.
Empresas.parkingBenefitDescription: Spacious parking areas for employees and visitors.
Empresas.yearEndLead: One of our most popular corporate experiences: events designed to close the year with entertainment, nature, great food and exclusive spaces for the entire team.
Empresas.yearEndDescription: Pools, barbecue areas, extensive green spaces, music, catering, recreational activities and complete coordination turn every event into a memorable experience for employees, management teams and their families.
Empresas.trainingDescription: We organize training sessions, seminars, conferences and corporate events in a natural setting. We offer one-day or multi-day programs, with or without accommodation, adapting to the needs of each organization.
Empresas.trainingServicesDescription: Our programs include climate-controlled meeting rooms, audiovisual equipment, coffee breaks, lunches, catering, accommodation in comfortable cabins, ample parking and all the services required for a first-class professional experience.
Empresas.withStayDescription: Ideal for team-building programs and multi-day events.
Empresas.withoutStayDescription: Perfect for meetings, courses and one-day training sessions.
Empresas.coffeeBreakDescription: Food and beverage options tailored to each event.
Empresas.teamBuildingDescription: Activities designed to strengthen integration, leadership and teamwork.
Empresas.solutionsSubtitle: From worksite accommodation to year-end celebrations, everything in one place.
Empresas.solutionAccommodationDescription: Package rates with full board for personnel working in the field.
Empresas.solutionMeetingsDescription: Business sessions with fully equipped rooms and accommodation included.
Empresas.solutionSeminarsDescription: Two event rooms with capacity for 100 and 250 people.
Empresas.solutionDinnersDescription: Restaurant with capacity for 200 people, ideal for anniversaries and award ceremonies.
Empresas.solutionYearEndDescription: Meals, pools and team-building activities for your team.
Empresas.solutionToursDescription: End the day visiting wineries, local distilleries and attractions throughout the Itata Valley.
Empresas.agreementsDescription: We develop corporate partnerships so employees of participating companies can enjoy exclusive discounts, ongoing promotions and preferential rates on accommodation, dining, recreational activities and services at Valle del Sol Quillón.
Empresas.promotionsDescription: Exclusive benefits for employees and their families.
Empresas.experiencesDescription: Priority access to activities and special programs.
Empresas.ctaDescription: Our team will support you throughout the planning of meetings, training sessions, conferences, celebrations and team-building activities, fully adapting to the needs of your organization.

TourOperadores.heroImageAlt: Group tourism at Valle del Sol
TourOperadores.heroDescription: We design tourism programs for national and international groups looking to discover the Itata Valley from a unique destination surrounded by nature, gastronomy and unforgettable experiences.
TourOperadores.introDescription: At Valle del Sol Quillón, we work with tour operators, travel agencies and trip organizers to offer complete programs for groups, combining accommodation, gastronomy, recreational activities and sightseeing routes in one destination.
TourOperadores.introDescriptionSecond: Our team coordinates every detail to make each trip comfortable, safe and memorable, adapting to the needs of every group and providing personalized service from arrival through departure.
TourOperadores.introImageAlt: Tour operators at Valle del Sol
TourOperadores.nationalTourismDescription: We develop programs specially designed for groups seeking to discover Quillón and the Itata Valley with comfort, safety and a fully organized experience.
TourOperadores.seniorDescription: We create programs specially designed for senior groups, prioritizing comfort, quality gastronomy, recreation and attentive service throughout their stay.
TourOperadores.delegationsDescription: We welcome groups from across Chile, coordinating tourism programs for clubs, associations, senior centers, institutions and organizations seeking a complete experience in Quillón.
TourOperadores.delegationsImageAlt: Group delegations at Valle del Sol
TourOperadores.internationalTourismDescription: We coordinate the complete experience from the moment passengers arrive in Chile, providing accommodation, gastronomy, transportation and sightseeing so every journey is comfortable, safe and worry-free.
TourOperadores.airportTransferDescription: We coordinate private transfers to and from the airport, welcoming every group with punctuality and comfort.
TourOperadores.delegationReceptionDescription: Our team welcomes each group and coordinates every detail of the tourism program.
TourOperadores.internationalAccommodationDescription: Comfortable cabins and spaces prepared for groups of different sizes throughout their stay.
TourOperadores.localGastronomyDescription: Menus specially prepared for groups, highlighting traditional flavors from the region.
TourOperadores.touristTransportDescription: We support the logistical coordination of excursions and tours to the destination's main attractions.
TourOperadores.customProgramsDescription: Each itinerary is adapted to the available time, the group's interests and the season.
TourOperadores.integralDescription: We work with national and international travel agencies and tour operators to provide a comprehensive solution that centralizes accommodation, meals, activities and logistics in one destination.
TourOperadores.integralImageAlt: International tourism at Valle del Sol
TourOperadores.journeyDescription: We coordinate every stage of the program so passengers can enjoy the destination without worries, while tour operators have reliable support throughout the entire journey.
TourOperadores.journeyArrivalDescription: Group reception at the airport or meeting point.
TourOperadores.journeyTransferDescription: Comfortable and safe transportation to Valle del Sol Quillón.
TourOperadores.journeyGastronomyDescription: Lunches, dinners and local cuisine throughout the stay.
TourOperadores.journeyExcursionsDescription: Wineries, local distilleries, nature and heritage throughout the Itata Valley.
TourOperadores.journeyFreeTimeDescription: Pools, green areas and recreational activities.
TourOperadores.journeyReturnDescription: Coordination of departure and the group's return journey.
TourOperadores.reasonInfrastructureDescription: Accommodation, restaurant, pools and spacious facilities all in one place.
TourOperadores.reasonGroupProgramsDescription: Experience organizing trips for national and international delegations.
TourOperadores.reasonLocationDescription: An excellent starting point for exploring Quillón and the Itata Valley.
TourOperadores.reasonGastronomyDescription: Group-friendly menus and cuisine inspired by local flavors.
TourOperadores.reasonAttentionDescription: Continuous support before, during and after every program.
TourOperadores.reasonExperiencesDescription: Nature, culture, wineries and activities for all ages.
TourOperadores.ctaImageAlt: Tour operators at Valle del Sol
TourOperadores.ctaTitle: Let's design your next tourism program
TourOperadores.ctaDescription: Our team can help you create programs for seniors, delegations, group travel and international visitors, incorporating accommodation, gastronomy, excursions and experiences tailored to each group.

Nosotros.heroSubtitle: We want to create an experience that remains in the memory of every visitor.
Nosotros.historyParagraphOne: Our story began in 2023, when we decided to leave office life in Santiago behind and pursue a shared dream: to create a unique tourism experience that would connect our visitors with nature and local culture.
Nosotros.historyParagraphTwo: With this clear vision, we embarked on a project that brings together a network of local suppliers and producers, adding authenticity while supporting the economic growth of our community.
Nosotros.felipeDescription: Responsible for commercial relationships and strategic development.
Nosotros.camilaDescription: Responsible for making sure everything runs perfectly in every experience.
Nosotros.finalQuote: We are the time we spend with those we love
